subject: Pilot readiness: hosted endpoint slices, rate window, and VPC evaluation
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@cloudcart.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — endpoints, rate windows, and VPC question

Hey Irene,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the throughput numbers looked promising. A few items we want to lock down before committing to a pilot:

- Which hosted endpoint setup would you recommend for our use case (short customer support prompts + batch embedding jobs)?
- For hosted pilots, how does Redwood define rate windows and burst behavior — we need predictable ceilings for our front-line app.
- Is there a simple path to test VPC/private connectivity later if the pilot goes well, or do we need to opt for Dedicated now?

I've looped in Penny (infrastructure) and Sean is cc'd from your side. Can you send a short recap with proposed next steps and any small asks so we can align with procurement?

—Alex
Alex Romero
Head of Product, CloudCart
alex.romero@cloudcart.com

Attachment: agenda-demo-20290517.pdf (attachment stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@cloudcart.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — endpoints, rate windows, and VPC question

Thanks Alex — great questions. Quick recap below with proposed next steps.

1) Recommended hosted endpoint topology
- For your mixed workload (low-latency chat + periodic embedding batches) we recommend a split endpoint approach:
  * "chat" endpoint optimized for low latency (short sequences, hot KV cache, smaller batching window)
  * "embed" endpoint provisioned for throughput (larger concurrent batchers, higher token throughput).
- During the pilot we can provision sandbox endpoints that mirror production slices so you can validate latency and cost.

2) Rate windows and burst behavior (hosted)
- Default: a soft rate window is enforced per endpoint (tokens/sec) with short bursts allowed for 30s.
- For pilots we can set explicit rate ceilings and a burst budget you control; if you hit a ceiling we return 429 + Retry-After.
- Suggested quickstart values (we can adjust after traffic profiling): chat = 200 reqs/min, embed = 10 concurrent batches of 256.

3) VPC/private connectivity path
- Private VPC is supported as a next step: the typical flow is pilot on Hosted API -> evaluate metrics -> migrate to Private VPC (same API surface) or Dedicated if you require reserved GPUs.
- You do NOT need to start with Dedicated to test private connectivity; we can schedule a VPC evaluation during or immediately after pilot.

Next steps (proposed):
- I will share a short Pilot MAP (attached) with endpoint definitions, suggested rate ceilings, and a one-week profiling window.
- Penny/infra: can you confirm whether CloudCart's security team requires SOC2 evidence or additional controls before the pilot? If so, we included a SOC2 questionnaire in attachments.
- Sean and Monica will coordinate sandbox provisioning; timeline estimate: 2 business days after we get confirmation on traffic slices.

If that looks good I'll send a consolidated MTP and calendar invite for a kickoff.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudCart-Pilot-MAP.xlsx, SOC2-Questionnaire.pdf

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: CloudCart pilot — rate ceilings and sandbox tasks

Team — quick internal note to align before I reply to Penny/Alex:

- Proposed sandbox slices:
  * chat-endpoint: 2 small replicas, 200 reqs/min ceiling, prefix cache enabled (30MB)
  * embed-endpoint: 1 larger replica, batch size 256, concurrency 10
- Can Sean own provisioning and share endpoint URLs?
- Ben, can you confirm whether the 429 behavior will surface an explicit Retry-After header for their client SDKs? If not, let's add it to the pilot runbook.
- Monica, I'll need an up-to-date SOC2 evidence package (cert + summary) to send if they ask.

I will send the external next steps once I have confirmations.

Thanks — Irene

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: CloudCart pilot — rate ceilings and sandbox tasks

Irene / team — quick answers: 
- 429 behavior: yes, we include Retry-After with a recommended backoff. We'll also emit a structured error code (RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) and a token-level metric in the console so they can instrument alerts.
- Provisioning: Sean, please spin the sandbox and ping irene with the two endpoint hostnames.
- I'll add a one-paragraph note to the MAP about fallback policy (how we degrade by routing to a cheaper model variant if quota exhausted).

Ben

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@cloudcart.com>, Penny Ortiz <penny.ortiz@cloudcart.com>

Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP and kickoff ask — CloudCart hosted pilot

Alex / Penny — thanks for the call and for the clarifying question on VPC. Attached is the short Pilot MAP with endpoint slices and suggested rate ceilings. Summary of ask and next actions below: 

1) Confirm traffic targets for the profiling week:
  - Chat: ~150–250 reqs/min (we've proposed 200)
  - Embeddings: bursts of up to 10 concurrent batches of 256 tokens

2) Security evidence: Penny, please confirm if SOC2 cert + questionnaire are sufficient or whether your security team needs anything else from our side. Monica attached a short SOC2 summary and the full questionnaire.

3) Sandbox provisioning: Sean will provision two sandbox endpoints once you confirm the traffic slices (ETA: 2 business days).

4) VPC path: We will run the pilot on Hosted API. If you want private connectivity after pilot, we can schedule a VPC evaluation — no need to start on Dedicated now.

5) Calendar & kickoff: If this plan looks good, please reply with an approval line and preferred kickoff window (we can do a 30–45 minute kickoff this week).

Links and attachments: Pilot MAP (attached), SOC2 questionnaire (attached), HubSpot deal link.

Looking forward —
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
